QuestInfo.name: Elite Player's Gift
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator is talking to you.
QuestInfo.1: You have received a gift from the Administrator.
QuestInfo.2: You received a gift from the Administrator. Level up until you become an Elite Player.

0.0: Hello, #h0#! You already reached Lv. 30? Amazing! Now, for that gift that I promised... Are you ready?

yes.0: Open your Inventory and double-click on the gift. This will give you a really special look. Oh, and one more thing: When you reach Lv. 50, I'll have some more gifts for you! Keep up the good work!

no.0: Oh, you don't want a gift? Okay. Talk to me if you change your mind.
